spec_raw: Button xs small button text gets pixelated after upgrading from 1.0.5 to 1.0.6

spec_refined.title: Button: fix xs size text rendering (pixelation after upgrade)
spec_refined.description: The xs size button renders with pixelated text in 1.0.6+, visible as blurred or aliased fonts at small sizes. This is a CSS/tailwind class regression - no JavaScript logic change required.
acceptance_criteria: xs size button text renders crisply (no subpixel blur visible)
The xs button applies the correct DaisyUI btn-xs class
No transform, scale, or skew is applied that would cause font blurring
All existing button spec tests still pass
spec_refined.technical_notes: Check modus-wc-button.tailwind.ts for the xs size class mapping and any accidentally introduced CSS transforms.
